project_type: React 18 SPA with TypeScript (strict), Vite bundler, Zustand state management
build_system: Vite + npm; tsconfig uses path alias @/* -> src/*
test_framework: Vitest with jsdom environment, @testing-library/react, setup in src/test-setup.ts
build_command: cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vite build
test_command: cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest run
verification_instructions: 1. Run build command to confirm TypeScript compiles without errors. 2. Run test command to confirm all tests pass. 3. Check typecheck: unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx tsc --noEmit
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network mode. NODE_OPTIONS env var must be unset before running node tools (proxy-bootstrap issue). No docker daemon available for docker build.
contribution_requirements: TypeScript strict mode. Inline styles used throughout (no CSS framework). Components use data-testid attributes. Zustand stores follow create() pattern. Supabase queries use fromTable() helper for perfecity schema.
key_patterns: 1. Pages are in src/pages/ and re-exported from src/pages/index.ts. 2. Components organized in subdirectories with index.ts barrel files (e.g., src/components/SkuBrowser/). 3. Stores in src/stores/ with __tests__ subfolder. 4. ProtectedRoute uses Outlet pattern. 5. Types in src/types/database.ts with enums and interfaces. 6. Tests mock @/lib/supabase with vi.mock(). 7. Inline styles for all UI (no Tailwind/CSS modules). 8. Dashboard cards navigate via useNavigate().
directory_structure: frontend/src/ contains: main.tsx (router), App.tsx (canvas), pages/ (route pages), components/ (organized in feature directories), stores/ (Zustand), lib/ (supabase client), types/ (database types), hooks/, canvas/ (Konva canvas logic)
